title: Calibrate fail-fast heuristics and capture rollout lessons for canary/A/B/shadow failures
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: After a recent partially degraded canary/A-B/shadow rollout that triggered an automated rollback, we need to (1) calibrate our fail-fast heuristics to reduce false positives and missed degradations, (2) close identified telemetry and contract gaps that delayed diagnosis, and (3) update runbooks and automated safety checks so on-call can restore service with minimal manual coordination. This ticket captures concrete follow-ups from the incident, owners, and verification steps.

Scope and goals:
- Audit and tune the heuristic thresholds used by the rollout controller (error-rate, latency p95/p99 deltas, embedding drift scores, model-output-quality regression signals).
- Add synthetic shadow-replay tests that run during rollout windows to validate KV cache interactions and prefix-caching behavior under realistic request mixes.
- Implement a shadow divergence detector that compares shadow output embeddings and top-k token distributions against baseline to surface semantic regressions earlier.
- Reduce rollback hysteresis: implement a 3-stage actuation (alert-only -> partial rollback -> full rollback) with configurable wait windows per signal to avoid cascade rollbacks from transient noise.
- Fill telemetry contract gaps: ensure per-variant trace IDs, consistent metric tags (variant, rollout_id, shadow=true/false), and quicker retention of heavy-sample traces for 2 hours post-fail.
- Update the post-deploy runbook with step-by-step diagnostic playbook, ownership handoff checklist, and a documented ‘quick confirm’ flow for safe re-rollout.

Acceptance criteria:
1) New thresholds and hysteresis logic implemented behind a feature flag; unit + integration tests added.
2) Shadow replay harness merged to CI and a synthetic scenario reproducing the incident runs green in staging.
3) Runbook updated and reviewed by on-call and SRE; a 30-minute tabletop carried out with notes captured.
4) Dashboard panels added: rollout_heatmap, shadow_divergence, variant_kv_collision_rate.
5) Postfix rollout (30% traffic) remains stable across 3 independent synthetic runs before unflagging.

Out of scope: major model architecture changes, retraining pipelines, or billing/quotas work. Those will be separate follow-ups if required.
